server.instructions: Crow Memory — Inkumbulo yangaphandle ye-sinapse yama-ejenti e-AI abhala ikhodi. Igcina isitayela sakho sokubhala ikhodi, ukuqonda kwakho amaphutha, nezintandokazi ze-akhithikheji njengama-matrikhi ezisindo ancishisiwe ku-crow.bin.

crow_memory_bias.description: Ibhulokhi ye-bias ye-Crow Memory efakwa ngokuzenzakalela. Iqukethe isitayela sakho sokubhala ikhodi, izintandokazi zakho, nemithetho ethuthukisiwe. Umphathi (host) kufanele ayilode ekuqaleni kweseshini.

crow_evolved_rules.description: Permanent evolved rules from Crow's system_prompt.md: permanent rules (human-promoted via CROW_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus unreviewed model suggestions.

crow_recall.description: Khumbula isitayela sokubhala ikhodi esiqondene nomsebenzisi, ukuqonda ngamaphutha, izintandokazi ze-akhithikheji, noma umongo womuntu siqu kusuka enkumbulweni ye-sinapse ye-Crow. Shayela lokhu NGAPHAMBI kwempendulo ngayinye ukuze uhambisane ne-inductive bias yomsebenzisi. Ngokuzenzakalelayo (register=all noma kushiyiwe, domain=all), kubuza wonke ama-register ayi-8 futhi kuhlanganisa imiphumela emhlabeni wonke ngokufana okusebenzayo.

parameters.register: I-register okufanele isetshenziswe. Sebenzisa 'all' (noma uyeke) ukuze ubuze wonke ama-register esizindeni esikhethiwe. Code: style/bug/arch/context. Life: life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context.
parameters.domain: Isihlungi sesizinda esisetshenziswa lapho i-register ingu-'all' noma ishiyiwe. 'code' = style/bug/arch/context, 'life' = life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context, 'all' = wonke ama-register ayi-8 (okuzenzakalelayo).
parameters.format: Ifomethi yokuphuma. 'hint' ibuyisela amacebo e-JSON (okuzenzakalelayo); 'bias_block' ibuyisela ibhulokhi yombhalo [User Bias] yokufakwa ku-system prompt.
parameters.project: Ithegi yephrojekthi esetshenziswa ukukhulisa amacebo ephrojekthi efanayo nokuhlunga noma ukujezisa lawo aphuma kwenye iphrojekthi.
parameters.strict_project: Uma kungu-true, isusa ngokuphelele amacebo avela kwenye iphrojekthi emiphumeleni.

crow_ingest.description: Faka isipiliyoni sokubhala ikhodi enkumbulweni ye-sinapse yesikhathi eside ye-Crow. Shayela NGEMUVA kwemiphumela yokwakha noma yokuhlola, noma ngemva kwempendulo eqondile yomsebenzisi. Nikeza i-polarity eqondile noma i-exit_code yokwakha ukuze i-polarity ihlelwe ngokuzenzakalela. Okuqukethwe kuhlanjululwa kuqala; okungenayo okuyimpempe kuphela kuyaliwa ngaphandle kokuthinta inkumbulo.

parameters.polarity: Amandla okuqinisa [-2.0, 2.0]. Akuphoqelekile uma i-exit_code inikeziwe; i-polarity eqondile iyanqoba uma kokubili kunikeziwe.
parameters.exit_code: Ikhodi yokuphuma yokwakha (0 = impumelelo). Ihlelwa ngokuzenzakalela ku-polarity (+1.5/+0.5 uma kuphumelele, -0.5/-1.0 uma kuhlulekile) ngaphandle uma i-polarity eqondile inikeziwe.
parameters.user_edited: Ukuthi umsebenzisi ulungise umphumela we-AI. Ilungisa i-polarity esuselwe ku-exit_code.
parameters.project: Ithegi yephrojekthi egcinwa kanye nokufakwa enkumbulweni ukuze kamuva kukhunjulwe ngokuqaphela iphrojekthi.

crow_admin.description: Imisebenzi yokuphatha ye-Crow kwithuluzi elilodwa. Izenzo: diagnostics (izibalo zenkumbulo), drift (ukuhlola i-drift), prompt (ukufunda/ukwengeza/izibalo ze-system_prompt.md), backup (ukudala/ukushintshanisa/ukuhluza/ukubuyisela), evolve (ukuphakamisa izinguquko ze-prompt), project_info (ukuhluza/ukudala izimo zephrojekthi).

parameters.action: Umuphi umsebenzi wokuphatha: diagnostics, drift, prompt, backup, evolve, noma project_info.
parameters.args: Into yama-agumenti eqondene nesenzo edluliselwa kumsebenzi okhethiwe.

recall_messages.faint_bias: I-Crow ikhumbula i-bias ye-{register} elula. Zimbalwa izinkumbulo ezigciniwe kuze kube manje.

evolve_messages.no_patterns: Awekho amaphethini abalulekile ngokwezibalo atholakele kuze kube manje.

drift_messages.confused: Inkumbulo ye-Crow ibonakala ididekile. Imisebenzi yakamuva kungenzeka ukuthi misha kakhulu noma inkumbulo igcwele. Cabanga nge-spectral reset noma ngokugcina imibhalo yakudala.

system_prompt.subtitle:
> Le mithetho yathuthukiswa yi-Crow futhi yavunywa umsebenzisi.
> Imele ama-bias okubhala ikhodi abalulekile ngokwezibalo.
> Ungayilungisi ngesandla — sebenzisa amathuluzi okuthuthukisa e-Crow MCP.
default_rules: RULE: Ngaphambi kwempendulo ngayinye, shayela i-crow_recall(domain="all") ukuze ubuze wonke ama-register ayi-8 (style, bug, arch, context, life_pref, life_avoid, life_phil, life_context) mayelana nesitayela somsebenzisi sokubhala ikhodi, ukuqonda kwakhe amaphutha, izintandokazi ze-akhithikheji, ukuthanda kwakhe, ifilosofi, kanye nomongo wamanje. Bonisa amacebo abuyisiwe empendulweni yakho.

RULE: Ngemva kwempendulo ngayinye, faka lokho umsebenzisi akuvezile — izintandokazi, ifilosofi, izilungiso, umongo — nge-crow_ingest. Hlulela wena i-register ne-polarity efanele ngaphandle kokulinda ukuthi umsebenzisi athi "khumbula lokhu." Ngemva komsebenzi wekhodi, hlola imiphumela yokwakha ngokuzenzakalela nge-crow_ingest_from_build.
RULE: Ungayeqi imithetho ye-recall+ingest ngisho emisebenzini engeyona eyekhodi njengokuhlela imibhalo, ukusebenza kwe-git, noma izinguquko zokucofwa. Yenza njalo.
